frameworks.title: Two genders, two articles
frameworks.body: Le (m) and la (f). Memorise gender WITH each new noun.

frameworks.title: Liaison
frameworks.body: Final consonants are silent UNLESS the next word starts with a vowel.

frameworks.title: Nasal vowels
frameworks.body: An, on, in, un — air through the nose, no final 'n' sound.

frameworks.title: Tu vs Vous
frameworks.body: Tu = friends. Vous = strangers, elders, professionals. When unsure, use vous.
